title: Store Network Outage Response
description: Store network failures affecting retail operations
triggers: Complete network outage at store locations
Wireless network failures in sales areas
immediate_actions: Identify scope of network failure (single store vs multi-store)
Implement emergency network bypass if available
Notify store managers of connectivity status
investigation_steps: Check network device status at affected stores
Verify ISP connectivity and circuit status
Analyze network traffic patterns for anomalies
resolution_steps: Restart failed network devices following standard procedures
Implement redundant network paths if available
Coordinate with ISP for circuit issues
Apply network configuration fixes or rollbacks
verification: Verify wireless network coverage in sales areas
Test remote access for store staff
special_considerations: Sales areas have highest priority for network restoration
Coordinate with store managers for minimal disruption
Document network topology changes made during incident
